pictures.author: Dosseman
pictures.observed: Pale stone exterior, lead hipped roof with brick dentils, rectangular dark windows, salmon upper annex and multiple square brick chimneys with pale pierced cowls. Tower of Justice remains independent.

pictures.author: Ray Swi-hymn
pictures.observed: Narrow court, projecting pale upper story, dark timber corbels, barred rectangular upper/lower windows, broad red timber soffits and descending stair access; neighboring court wall retains stone/brick relieving arches.

pictures.author: Ray Swi-hymn
pictures.observed: Entry fountain: pale recessed arched niche and shallow round bowl, blue tiled surrounds and reddish timber soffit. Fine patterns and inscriptions will not be copied.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Named L-shaped Halberdiers quarters/service range on way32396154. Retain its exact notched exterior and open court outside the L, reconstruct a narrow head court, pale stone outer elevations, selected pale/salmon plaster inner elevations, lead hips, brick/cowl chimneys, projecting upper story with timber corbels, actual entrances and stair approach. No Tower of Justice, independent colonnade, private inscriptions, museum furniture or visitors. The small head courtyard is a picture-led reconstruction within the mapped exterior, not an OSM courtyard survey. The long service range uses three conservative floor steps from the retained grade rather than one oversized plinth. Detailed internal room inventory remains approximate.
